title: EN 81-20 maximum car area (through makers and the Hong Kong code)
edition: EN 81-20:2020 Table 6, as restated by makers, CIBSE and the Hong Kong lift code (Table 1)
notes: EN 81-20 itself was not read, so findings are advisory. Rows below 450 kg rest on search snippets only. Above 2500 kg the area grows 0.16 m² per 100 kg (the Hong Kong code applies that from 1600 kg, a local rule not used here).

car_area.description: Maximum available car area for a passenger lift's rated load

glass.description: Car walls of laminated glass fixed on all edges: toughened laminated at least 8 mm (4 + 4 + 0.76) for a panel whose inscribed circle is up to 1 m, 10 mm (5 + 5 + 0.76) up to 2 m; beyond, pendulum tests. A handrail 0.9–1.1 m above the floor, fixed independently of the glass, where glass reaches below 1.1 m. Well glass is laminated.
